whenCanIExpect.title: When can I expect to receive payments for Senior Freeze, ANCHOR, and Stay NJ?

content.text1: Even though PAS-1 combines all 3 programs into 1 application, each program has a different payment schedule. The table below outlines when you can expect to receive your payment(s) from each program that you are eligible for.
content.text2: Your payment will be delayed if there is an issue with your application, or if we need additional information from you.

julToSep.text1: Payments start going out on July 15, 2026. If you applied before May 1, you can expect to receive your payment between July 15 and September 15.
julToSep.text2: Stay NJ is paid in quarterly installments. The 2025 benefit will be paid in February and May of 2027.

sepToOct.text1: If you applied between May 1 and June 1, you can expect to receive your payment between September 1 and October 1.
sepToOct.text2: Payments start going out on September 15, 2026. You can expect to get your payment before December 1, 2026.

nov.text: If you applied between June 2 and September 1, you can expect to receive your payment between November 2 and January 2, 2027.

dec.text: If you applied between September 2 and October 31, you can expect to receive your payment between December 2, 2026 and February 2, 2027.
